info.title: CLU Store API
info.description: V1 uses {success,data,meta} success envelopes and {success:false,error} failures; 204/HEAD/conditional/static/docs responses can be bodyless or use their declared media type. Historical paths are functional, but payloads require a typed frontend adapter that unwraps data. All monetary response fields are decimal STRINGS in CNY. Model price is full base plus memory increment; never double-add startingPrice. Synthetic examples are illustrative and are NOT provisioned accounts, SKUs or orders. IDs must be selected from the local catalog. JWT is HS256 only, issuer/audience checked, default TTL 900s with env-only strong key. ADMIN decisions are terminal and transactional. Global JSON limit, allowlisted CORS, Helmet and rate limits apply; 401 denotes invalid credentials/token, 403 wrong role or blocked origin. Input Zod refinements (confirmation equality, normalized identity rules, cursor decoding/sort matching and business limits) remain authoritative where JSON Schema cannot express them. API reads reject unknown/repeated query keys where their runtime schema declares a strict query. X-Request-Id is server-generated. No production seed credentials or remote origins are embedded.

get.description: Only active offers with startsAt <= now and endsAt > now; null bounds are unbounded. Historical 2025 campaigns remain inactive. Marketing soldOut is independent of SKU stock.
Ordered by displayOrder ASC,id ASC. Linked productId may be null for non-product editorial cards.

Literal case-insensitive substring search across product name/title/category title or slug. Unknown category filters return an empty list. ID breaks sort ties. Unknown/repeated query keys are rejected. page default 1/max 10000; pageSize default 20/max 100. newest sorts createdAt DESC; prices use Decimal startingPrice; name sorts use DB collation; ties use id ASC. Memory price is incremental.

post.description: JSON {} purchases the CURRENT USER persisted cart. Direct full-SKU body is optional compatibility mode and leaves the cart unchanged. Live full ProductModel.price + ProductMemorySize.extraPrice, using Decimal; startingPrice is never added. CNY amounts are fixed two-decimal strings. Legacy names/images/prices are bounded and discarded. Limits: 99 units/line, 50 configurations and 500 units/cart. One Read Committed PostgreSQL transaction owner-locks, revalidates/reprices, creates pending order/items/history/receipt and consumes purchased cart lines atomically. Optional Idempotency-Key: 1–128 ASCII characters; duplicates rejected; per-user unique key and persisted SHA-256 fingerprint. Replay is checked BEFORE empty/stock checks and returns the exact prior creation receipt with 200 even after cart refill/status change. First create 201. Changed direct payload/mode with same key 409. Cart fingerprint denotes the purchase intent, not mutable contents; use a new key for a new purchase. Keyless direct requests lack replay guarantees. P2034 serialization/deadlock retries: max 3 attempts with 20/40ms waits; exhausted 503 CHECKOUT_BUSY. No inventory reservation, tax/shipping/payment or client totals.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional case-sensitive purchase-intent key. Header name case-insensitive. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]*$, length 1–128; repeated headers rejected.

get.description: Own orders only, even for ADMIN. Owner/time/ID or global time/ID indexed cursor pagination. newest = createdAt DESC,id DESC; oldest reverses both. pageSize defaults to 20, max 100. Cursor is an opaque versioned position, max 256 characters, reused with the same sort; never an authorization credential. No page/offset/count/search parameters. Each response uses one Repeatable Read snapshot.

get.summary: Read owned order or ADMIN-visible order
get.description: Owner or ADMIN. Foreign USER and missing ID return identical ORDER_NOT_FOUND. Current state, immutable purchase snapshots and ordered status history; no account relation or internal receipt metadata. P07 placement replay remains the original pending receipt.

post.description: ADMIN only, with transaction-time role recheck under an operator share lock. Only pending -> approved or pending -> rejected; terminal states cannot change. A conditional PostgreSQL UPDATE and initial-to-terminal history insertion commit atomically. Opposite concurrent decisions yield one 200 and one 409. Immutable snapshots and the P07 creation receipt are preserved. No payments or payment URI. Optional metadata is a trimmed plain {note} (raw <=1000, normalized 1–500, no controls); a deprecated string becomes a note and is never parsed as JSON.
